elle: quick RFC follow-up re: onboarding pipeline -> we need a small, auditable smoke descriptor + compatibility tags. keeping it minimal so teams can get fast signoff.
elle: core idea: descriptor carries a compact `smoke_profile` and `compat_tags`; bench + admit use those for cheap validation and routing.
ravi: can you sketch the minimal fields?
elle: proposal snippet (conceptual):
```
smoke_profile: seqlen_samples=[16,128,512], warmup_iters=32, token_cap=5k
compat_tags: [\"kv-basic\", \"attn-fuse-v1\"]
```
noah: prefer these be explicit fields in the descriptor repo so console can surface diffs and draft promotions.
sara: operational constraints: auto-gen allowed but must include provenance stamp `generated_by` and `generated_at`. Bench auto-gen should create a draft, not overwrite owner descriptors.
bench-bot: [auto] when smoke_profile missing -> create draft in catalog/drafts/<model> with generated_by=bench-auto.
ravi: trust model: treat smoke_profile as HINT initially. After pilot (6w) require owner sign-off to treat as authoritative.
noah: compatibility check: require `quant_abi_version` for quant artifacts else block. Admit-bot should return clear remediation steps, e.g. `redwood-admit attach-abi --version qv1`.
admit-bot: [auto] rule: missing quant_abi_version -> FAIL + remediation snippet.
sara: bench should tag smoke results with `descriptor_hash`, `smoke_version` and `tokenizer_fingerprint` so we can triage regressions. Keep these fields immutable in catalog snapshots.
elle: UX: drafts must be reviewable in console with one-click accept/promote. If not accepted in 30 days, they remain draft and bench continues to use cluster defaults.
ravi: scheduling: heavy deep-bench only if `bench_budget` allowed. Add bench_budget (token-hours) in descriptor to gate deep runs. Default small value so we don't overcommit.
noah: runtime mapping: instead of big matrices, use short `compat_tags` and `min_runtime_version`. Runtime teams map tags->feature flags.
sara: alerts: add `seqlen_drift_alert` rule: compare production histograms week-over-week; if KL > threshold -> emit alert and mark descriptor for re-sample. Jia will propose thresholds in follow-up.
enne: (typo) elle: action items:
- elle: open descriptor schema PR with smoke_profile, compat_tags, bench_budget by Tue.
- ravi + bench: implement draft auto-gen + provenance stamp.
- sara: add admit-bot remediation snippets and console one-click promote.
- noah: coordinate runtime tag mapping with infra.
ravi: rollout plan: week0 optional+auto-gen; week4 require smoke_profile on new uploads; week8 require owner-signed smoke_profile for models > size threshold.
noah: small edgecase: tokenizers that change offsets must block admission until rebench; require tokenizer_fingerprint always.
bench-bot: [auto] when draft created -> include quick_smoke_cmd in draft: `redwood-smoke --model <id> --runs 10 --seqlen 16,128,512`.
admit-bot: [auto] created ticket /admit#2045 - smoke_profile + compat_tags in admit contract.\sara: ok let's take this to PR review, i'll add UX mocks. thanks all :thumbsup:
